evals.prompt: Add a Built with Microsoft Power Pages badge to the React app in samples/spa/react/file-upload/notes.
evals.expected_output: Copies the SVG into the project, renders a fixed badge in the app shell using the project's own styling conventions, and validates with the project's build command.
expectations: Copies the SVG into the target project instead of referencing the skill folder
Uses the exact label text Built with Microsoft Power Pages
Marks the logo decorative with alt empty and aria-hidden
Runs the project's existing build command to validate

evals.prompt: This Power Pages code site needs the powered-by badge, but the badge keeps covering the chat widget on mobile.
evals.expected_output: Adds or repositions the badge so it does not block primary UI on small screens, following the host site's responsive conventions.
expectations: Renders a single badge with a stable selector
Hides or repositions the badge on small screens
Does not cover navigation, toasts, or chat widgets

evals.prompt: Add the Power Pages badge to a code site that has a bundleFilePatterns list in powerpages.config.json.
evals.expected_output: Adds the badge and includes the emitted SVG asset in the deployment manifest so the badge image ships with the site.
expectations: Adds the emitted SVG pattern to bundleFilePatterns
References the project-local SVG copy from the component
Validates the build so the emitted asset name is known
